payload.reason: The evidence indicates that a new set of error categories was designed to improve granularity and practicality in error classification, which was not achievable with the previous tagsets.

claims.text: The new error scheme allows for evaluation at different levels of granularity, which was not possible with the previous tagsets.
The design of the new error categories aims to balance informativeness and practicality, addressing the limitations of existing tagsets.
The new framework includes 25 error types that can be categorized further, providing flexibility for detailed observations of system performance.
